description:
Who do you have to become to attract the person you want?

In today’s new @jillianonlove episode, I sit down with multiple NYT bestselling author and entrepreneur, Dean Graziosi @deangraziosi to discuss overcoming childhood trauma, avoidant attachment, choosing the best partner for you, and starting a business. This is one of THE BEST conversations I’ve had. He dropped so many gems and shares his journey from avoidance to security. Unreal.

From Avoidant to Secure: How to Overcome your Fear of Conflict with Dean Graziosi.

🎧Listen or watch today: on all podcast platforms.
transcript: I want this perfect woman that's in the personal development that will accept my older children as hers and does this and exercises and eat right and all these things. As I looked at this list and I feel really blessed that I saw it through this lens, I just felt this, wow, you're mighty high on yourself. Something in me made me realize, wow, if I want that, what kind of man do I need to become to attract that woman? Hmm.
